lore: A traveler's notebook for the one trader every village keeps.
use: The Simple Wanderers Guide explains the Village Wanderer, his horse, his stock and the biome goods. Craft it shapeless from a book and a lead.
secret: Its pages open in your language and nothing is consumed.

lore: A trader in an ochre cloak, folded into an egg.
use: Creative only. It spawns a Village Wanderer that belongs to no village: no record, no village seed, never counted. The wanderers of real villages appear on their own.
secret: Use it to test offers or to place a trader by hand; the offers still follow the biome around him.
